description: This Java class 'InvoiceWorker' provides utility methods for handling invoice calculations and data retrieval within the OFBiz accounting framework. It includes methods for computing invoice totals, tax amounts, retrieving related entities such as parties and addresses, and handling currency conversions related to invoices.

classes.name: InvoiceWorker
classes.description: A final utility class containing static methods for processing invoices within the OFBiz system, including calculations of totals, tax, and entity retrieval related to invoices.

methods.name: getInvoiceTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of an invoice, including tax, based on invoice ID or invoice GenericValue, with optional currency conversion.

methods.name: getInvoiceItemTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total for a single invoice item (quantity * amount).

methods.name: getInvoiceItemDescription
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for an invoice item, resolving product content, tax info, or item type description.

methods.name: getTaxableInvoiceItemTypeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of invoice item types that are taxable, identified by enumeration.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total tax amount associated with a given invoice.

methods.name: getInvoiceNoTaxTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total invoice amount excluding taxes.

methods.name: getBillToParty
methods.description: Retrieves the party responsible for billing on an invoice.

methods.name: getBillFromParty
methods.description: Retrieves the party from which the invoice is issued.

methods.name: getSendFromParty
methods.description: Retrieves the party that is sending the invoice.

methods.name: getShippingAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping address associated with the invoice, checking related shipment info if necessary.

methods.name: getBillToAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the billing address associated with the invoice.

methods.name: getSendFromAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the sender's address for the invoice.

methods.name: getInvoiceAddressByType
methods.description: Fetches an invoice address of a specific type, such as billing or shipping.

methods.name: getInvoiceNotApplied
methods.description: Calculates the remaining amount of an invoice that has not been applied or paid.

methods.name: getInvoiceApplied
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of an invoice that has been applied or paid.

methods.name: getInvoiceItemApplied
methods.description: Calculates the total applied amount for a specific invoice item.

methods.name: getInvoiceCurrencyConversionRate
methods.description: Determines the currency conversion rate for an invoice's currency relative to the organization's preferred currency.

methods.name: getInvoiceCurrencyConversionRate
methods.description: Retrieves the currency conversion rate given an invoice ID.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxByTaxAuthGeoAndParty
methods.description: Deprecated: Provides a detailed breakdown of invoice taxes by geographic and party attributes, returning a detailed list and grand total.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxAuthPartyAndGeos
methods.description: Gathers the set of tax authority parties and their geographic locations associated with an invoice.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxTotalForTaxAuthPartyAndGeo
methods.description: Calculates total tax for a specific tax authority party and geographic location within an invoice.

methods.name: getInvoiceUnattributedTaxTotal
methods.description: Calculates total tax for invoice items that are not attributed to any specific tax authority party.
